title.value: 3D Pre-Training Improves GNNs for Molecular Property Prediction
title.justification: The paper introduces a method called '3D Infomax' which pre-trains Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for molecular property prediction by encoding implicit 3D information from 2D molecular graphs.
title.quote: We propose pre-training a model to reason about the geometry of molecules given only their 2D molecular graphs.

extractions.description: The paper presents a method called '3D Infomax' which enhances Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) in predicting molecular properties by incorporating implicit 3D information using only 2D molecular graphs. The pre-training method uses self-supervised learning to maximize mutual information between 3D summary vectors and GNN representations, improving predictions on molecules with unknown geometry. The method shows significant improvements across various properties and enables effective representation transfer across datasets.
